do_not_use_when: you expect dialect detection; dialect and similar conditions must be declared (--declare), they are not inferred
you want the report to raise an evidentiary posture; the declared use case is informational only

examples.description: Declare a nonnative-English writer and check the baseline coverage

required: nothing required; supply at least --declare or --target for a useful report
inputs.target: optional target text, declared conditions and a manifest describing baseline language backgrounds

purpose: Linguistic-background caution surface. Reports per-condition flags (nonnative English, code-switching, dialect features, translation influence, speech-to-text, neurodivergent patterns, educational genre, institutional template), mostly declared and with heuristic code-switching detection on a target, and refuses evaluative or disciplinary use when the validation set lacks comparable language backgrounds.
use_when: before reading any SETEC signal about a writer whose first language is not English, who code-switches, or who writes in a dialect
checking whether a baseline or validation manifest covers the writer's language background
